crossRefs.note: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.
Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”
When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah.…
Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

translations.web: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man had ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.
translations.bsb: saying, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
